## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (and `npm run build` for page changes)

- [ ] A formula change has a golden-value test citing its source (book + equation, or paper + DOI)
- [ ] References and model tier in the registry entry are updated if the model changed
- [ ] Checked the page in a browser (no console errors; works at phone width)
